title: Full-stack AI Developer
description:
The Role

We are looking for a versatile Senior AI Full-Stack Developer who can build, ship, and utilise cutting-edge AI builder platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, AI Studio, Lovable, Base44, etc), cloud ecosystems (Vercel, AWS, etc), and backend tools (Supabase, Superwall, etc) to accelerate product development, and iterate on web and mobile-ready applications end-to-end, with a knowledge of modern frontend (Vue.js/Nuxt, Webflow) and backend (Python/Django, PostgreSQL).

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Utilize AI-first development engines and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Lovable, Base44, Vercel, Supabase, etc) to build, test, and iterate on features at lightning speed.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize scalable web applications using Vue.js (2/3), Nuxt, Python (Django/DRF), and PostgreSQL.
  • Design secure RESTful APIs, asynchronous tasks (Celery, Redis/RabbitMQ), OAuth flows, and third-party integrations including paywalls/monetization (Superwall) and payments.
  • Deploy and manage services using Docker, Vercel, AWS (S3, RDS, CloudFront, SQS), and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
  • Own features from technical requirements to testing, code reviews, release, and monitoring (Sentry).

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience across full-stack web and cloud applications.
  • Hands-on experience with AI development frameworks, low-code/AI builders (OpenAI, Anthropic, Lovable, Base44), and modern backend services (Supabase, Superwall).
  • Good knowledge of Vue.js (Vue 2/3, Nuxt 2/3/4), TypeScript/JS, HTML5/CSS3/Tailwind.
  • Good knowledge of Python with Django / Django REST Framework, ORM, caching (Redis), and relational databases (PostgreSQL).
  • Proficiency deploying on Vercel and AWS, containerizing with Docker, and managing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Language: Professional English proficiency (B2+).

 

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience migrating Webflow sites to Vue/Nuxt.
  • Knowledge of payment gateways (Mollie, Stripe, PayPal), media/PDF processing, or WebSockets.
  • Testing experience with Pytest, Jest, or Cypress.
